test_case_name: Equipment Action Reason Configuration - Browser Refresh Validation
business_intent: Verify that unsaved changes in Equipment Action Reason Configuration are discarded when the browser is refreshed, ensuring data integrity and preventing accidental additions without explicit save.
preconditions: Valid DSP user credentials available via environment variables DSP_USERNAME and DSP_PASSWORD
User has access to Configuration menu and Equipment Action Reason Configuration section
Base URL is accessible at DSP_BASE_URL environment variable
test_steps: Clear all browser cookies and cache
Click Next button on SSO page
Handle accept cookies popup if it appears
Click on Configuration icon from the left menu
Navigate to Equipment Action Reason Configuration section and verify it is displayed
Click on Add button in Equipment Action Reason Configuration section
Select 'Cancelled' Action from the Action dropdown
Enter reason 'Duplicate Waybill' in the Reason text box
Click on browser refresh button without saving changes
Verify the newly added reason 'Duplicate Waybill' for 'Cancelled' action is absent from the configuration table
expected_results: Login is successful via Microsoft SSO
Equipment Action Reason Configuration section is visible
Add form opens when Add button is clicked
Reason field accepts 'Duplicate Waybill' text input
After refresh, 'Duplicate Waybill' reason is NOT present in the configuration table
